tools.name: check_dns_propagation
tools.description: Check A, AAAA, MX, NS, and TXT answers for a hostname at the Cloudflare, Google, and Quad9 resolvers.

tools.name: check_domain_delegation
tools.description: List the delegation nameservers for a domain and the A and AAAA glue addresses for each one.

tools.name: check_dnssec
tools.description: Check the DS and DNSKEY records for a domain and whether a validating resolver sets the AD flag on its answers.

tools.name: trace_cname_chain
tools.description: Follow the CNAME chain for a hostname, up to 12 aliases, and report loops.

tools.name: lookup_domain_rdap
tools.description: Return the public RDAP registration summary for a domain. Registrant contact fields are not returned.

tools.name: lookup_ip_info
tools.description: Resolve a hostname, or take an IP address directly, and return RDAP network data and the ASN for each public address.

tools.name: check_forward_confirmed_rdns
tools.description: Check the PTR record for an IP address and whether the name it returns resolves back to the same address.

tools.name: check_tls_certificate
tools.description: Connect to a host on port 443 and return the TLS version, cipher, and certificate details including expiry and subject alternative names.

tools.name: check_tls_configuration
tools.description: Observe which TLS protocol versions a host accepts and summarize its TLS configuration.

tools.name: check_http_chain
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return each redirect hop with status codes and response headers.

tools.name: check_http_status
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return the final status after following redirects.

tools.name: measure_web_performance
tools.description: Measure DNS, connect, TLS, and time to first byte for a URL from the DotMoose diagnostic node. This is a network timing sample. It is not a browser rendering benchmark.

tools.name: check_website_security
tools.description: Review the security controls a site exposes in its public responses, including security headers, cookie attributes, and CORS policy.

tools.name: check_security_txt
tools.description: Fetch and parse the security.txt file for a site.

tools.name: check_compression
tools.description: Check whether a URL is served with gzip or Brotli compression and report the sizes with and without compression.

tools.name: check_ipv6_website
tools.description: Check whether a site answers over IPv6 and compare the result with IPv4.

tools.name: check_favicon
tools.description: Locate the favicon a site declares and report its URL, type, and size.

tools.name: audit_page_links
tools.description: Check up to 20 same-origin links found on one page and report the status of each. This is a single page check, not a site crawl.

tools.name: check_page_metadata
tools.description: Return the title, meta description, canonical URL, headings, hreflang entries, and JSON-LD types found on a page.

tools.name: test_robots_txt
tools.description: Fetch the robots.txt for a site and test whether a user agent may fetch a given path.

tools.name: validate_sitemap
tools.description: Fetch the sitemap for a site and report its structure, URL count, and fetch errors.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Read the SPF record for a domain and count the DNS lookup terms in the full include chain against the limit of 10.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Read the DMARC record published at _dmarc for a domain.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Read the DKIM public key record for a domain and selector.

tools.name: check_mx_records
tools.description: List the MX records for a domain with the A and AAAA addresses of each mail server.

tools.name: check_smtp_starttls
tools.description: Connect to the mail servers for a domain on port 25 and report the banner, EHLO response, and STARTTLS support. No mail is sent and no recipient is tested.

tools.name: check_mta_sts
tools.description: Read the MTA-STS DNS record and the published policy file for a domain.

tools.name: check_tls_rpt
tools.description: Read the TLS-RPT record published at _smtp._tls for a domain.

tools.name: check_bimi
tools.description: Read the BIMI record for a domain and selector. The selector defaults to default.

tools.name: check_ip_blacklists
tools.description: Check an IP address, or the public addresses a hostname resolves to, against the reviewed DNS blacklist providers.

tools.name: looking_glass_ping
tools.description: Send four ICMP echo probes from the DotMoose network in Canada to a public host or IP address.

tools.name: looking_glass_traceroute
tools.description: Trace the route from the DotMoose network in Canada to a public host or IP address, up to 20 hops with one probe per hop.

tools.name: looking_glass_path
tools.description: Sample the route from the DotMoose network in Canada to a public host or IP address, up to 20 hops with three probes per hop.

tools.name: calculate_subnet
tools.description: Compute the network address, broadcast or last address, and address counts for an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR block.

tools.name: ip_range_to_cidr
tools.description: Convert an IPv4 or IPv6 address range into the smallest set of CIDR blocks that covers it exactly.

tools.name: calculate_bandwidth
tools.description: Convert a link speed into maximum daily and monthly transfer, convert monthly transfer into an average rate, and estimate how long a file transfer takes at a given rate.

tools.name: estimate_storage_growth
tools.description: Project storage size over up to 120 months at a constant monthly growth rate.

tools.name: estimate_backup_retention
tools.description: Estimate backup storage for a grandfather-father-son retention plan where weekly and monthly copies are full backups and daily copies are increments.

tools.name: build_spf_record
tools.description: Assemble an SPF record from IP ranges, includes, and the a and mx mechanisms, and count its DNS lookup terms against the limit of 10.

tools.name: build_dmarc_record
tools.description: Assemble a DMARC record from a policy, optional subdomain policy, report addresses, and enforcement percentage.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_website_security" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Review the security controls a site exposes in its public responses, including security headers, cookie attributes, and CORS policy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_http_chain, check_http_status, check_website_security, check_compression, check_favicon, check_page_metadata, validate_sitemap · Private data: check_dnssec, lookup_domain_rdap, check_forward_confirmed_rdns, check_security_txt, check_spf, check_dmarc, check_dkim, check_mx_records, check_mta_sts, check_tls_rpt, check_bimi, calculate_bandwidth, build_spf_record, build_dmarc_record · Public sink: check_forward_confirmed_rdns, looking_glass_ping, calculate_subnet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_http_chain, check_http_status, check_website_security, check_compression, check_favicon, check_page_metadata, validate_sitemap · Private data: check_dnssec, lookup_domain_rdap, check_forward_confirmed_rdns, check_security_txt, check_spf, check_dmarc, check_dkim, check_mx_records, check_mta_sts, check_tls_rpt, check_bimi, calculate_bandwidth, build_spf_record, build_dmarc_record · Public sink: check_forward_confirmed_rdns, looking_glass_ping, calculate_subnet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
